question: Q-W-S1-D3
text: Compare FY2015 and FY2014 revenue by Buying Group and Customer Category.
interpretation: FY2015 vs FY2014 revenue by Buying Group and Customer Category (as-was customer attributes).
assemble: SELECT buying_group, customer_category, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2014 THEN revenue END) AS revenue_fy2014, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2015 THEN revenue END) AS revenue_fy2015, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2015 THEN revenue END) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2014 THEN revenue END), 0) - 1 AS change_pct FROM q WHERE lines > 0 GROUP BY buying_group, customer_category ORDER BY buying_group, customer_category
